domain: SaaS Dashboard for WhatsApp Bulk Messaging
global_philosophy: Precision, performance, and trust. The UI must feel like a high-end command center (Linear/Vercel style). 95% of the UI is monochrome (deep obsidian, varying neutral greys, pure white). Color is strictly functional: 'WhatsApp Green' is reserved EXCLUSIVELY for active states, delivery success, and connection status. No purple/violet AI slop. No default SaaS blue.

rules: Headings MUST use tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Use JetBrains Mono for metrics numbers, IDs, and variables in the message editor.

structural_rules: Sidebar: Fixed width (w-64 or w-72), h-screen, border-r border-neutral-800.
Main Content: flex-1, overflow-y-auto, min-h-screen, bg-neutral-950.
Optical Alignment: Ensure icon+text inside buttons is visually centered.
Grid Children: Grid items MUST be direct children of the grid container.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-neutral-950 font-bold hover:bg-neutral-200 transition-colors px-6 py-2.5 rounded-md
buttons.secondary: bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 text-neutral-50 hover:bg-neutral-800 transition-colors px-6 py-2.5 rounded-md
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-50 hover:bg-neutral-800/50 transition-colors px-4 py-2 rounded-md

cards.metric: bg-neutral-900/50 border border-neutral-800 rounded-lg p-6 flex flex-col justify-between hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-neutral-700 transition-all duration-300

inputs.text: bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-md px-4 py-2.5 text-neutral-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white/50 focus:border-white/50 transition-all placeholder:text-neutral-600
inputs.textarea: bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-md px-4 py-3 text-neutral-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white/50 focus:border-white/50 min-h-[120px] resize-y

whatsapp_chat_preview.container: bg-[#0b141a] border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-full
whatsapp_chat_preview.header: bg-[#202c33] px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-neutral-800
whatsapp_chat_preview.message_outgoing: bg-[#005c4b] text-white p-3 rounded-lg rounded-tr-none self-end max-w-[85%] text-sm shadow-sm
whatsapp_chat_preview.message_incoming: bg-[#202c33] text-white p-3 rounded-lg rounded-tl-none self-start max-w-[85%] text-sm shadow-sm
whatsapp_chat_preview.variables: bg-black/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[#00E676] font-mono text-xs

micro_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly define hover text and background colors (e.g., hover:bg-neutral-800 hover:text-white).
micro_interactions.focus_states: Inputs and buttons must use high-contrast focus rings (focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white/50).
micro_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition properties: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out or transition-transform for lifts.

accessibility.contrast: Text against backgrounds must pass WCAG AA. Lighter gray text (text-neutral-400) is for secondary info; critical info must be text-neutral-50.
accessibility.focus: Keyboard navigation must not be trapped. Focus states must be visible.

media.rules: DO NOT use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. Use the URLs provided below or Phosphor/Lucide icons.

urls.qr_code_placeholder: Use a generated SVG pattern or an explicitly designed purely CSS/Tailwind grid to simulate a QR code. Do not load a generic image for QR.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, specific table rows, nav links) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='sidebar-campaigns-link').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize the app with the dark theme colors explicitly mapped in tailwind.config.js (neutral-950 as app bg).
2. Add Fontshare imports for 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'Satoshi' in index.css. Apply them to headings and body respectively.
3. Build a fixed Sidebar Layout (Layout.js) with standard navigation (Dashboard, Campaigns, Contacts, Templates, Connections, Credits, Settings).
4. Construct the Dashboard screen using the 'Control Room' grid (grid-cols-4 for top metrics). Use Recharts for the delivery/failure graphs.
5. Create the 'New Campaign' flow which includes a split layout: Form/Variables on the left, and the 'whatsapp_chat_preview' component on the right simulating real-time rendering.
6. Build the WhatsApp Connections screen featuring a 'Connect' button that reveals a simulated QR code scanning interface.
7. Implement Shadcn UI components for Tables (Campaign List, Contacts) and dropdowns, but heavily override their styles to match the border-neutral-800 and pure white/black button aesthetic.
8. Ensure every single button, form, and interactable metric card has a data-testid attribute.
9. Do NOT use purple/violet gradients for AI features; use a sleek subtle glow (like pure white drop-shadow or border) with a Sparkle icon to indicate AI suggestions.
